newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodian authorities impose curfew on Phnom Penh.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian authorities impose curfew on Phnom Penh.

text.p: Authorities imposed a curfew in the Cambodian capital on Saturday after a day of clashes in the city between forces loyal to the country's rival prime ministers.
In a statement broadcast on national television and radio, Phnom Penh municipal authorities said the curfew was being imposed from 8 p.m. to 6 a.m.

Fighting erupted early on Saturday and continued intermittently through the day as forces loyal to powerful Second Prime Mininster Hun Sen moved against troops loyal to his rival, First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh.
The fighting appeared to have subsided as the curfew came into effect though the city remained tense and one local official reported clusters of rival troops in various parts of the city.
Military officials said casualty figures were not known but one local hospital reported four people dead and almost 20 wounded.
